"""Throwaway debug: tailor selection with outside-root document asset."""

import asyncio
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast
from unittest.mock import patch

from src.autopilot.contracts.base_state import OrchestrationState
from src.autopilot.graph.nodes.orchestration.tailor_documents import (
    node_tailor_documents,
    pre_generated_tailored_resume_path,
    select_existing_resume_result,
)


async def main() -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        tmp_path = Path(td)
        root = tmp_path / "resources" / "resumes" / "tailored"
        root.mkdir(parents=True)
        outside = tmp_path / "downloads"
        outside.mkdir()
        outside_pdf = outside / "cached-resume.pdf"
        outside_pdf.write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.4\n% x\n")
        tailored_pdf = root / "technical-product-manager_bloomberg_resume.pdf"
        tailored_pdf.write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.4\n% x\n")

        with (
            patch(
                "src.autopilot.graph.nodes.orchestration.tailor_documents._existing."
                "state.tailored_output_dir",
                lambda: root,
            ),
            patch(
                "src.autopilot.graph.nodes.orchestration.tailor_documents._existing."
                "selection.select_resume_role_lane_for_state",
                lambda *a, **k: None,
            ),
        ):
            field = {
                "control_id": "resume-upload",
                "form_id": "application",
                "widget_family": "file",
                "required": True,
                "selector_hint": "#resume-upload",
                "question_text": "Upload your resume",
            }
            state = cast(
                OrchestrationState,
                {
                    "messages": [],
                    "payload": {"fields": [field]},
                    "parsed_fields": [field],
                    "actions": [],
                    "job_metadata_result": {
                        "title": "Technical Product Manager",
                        "company": "Bloomberg",
                    },
                    "profile_data": {"attachments": {"resume": str(outside_pdf)}},
                    "config": {},
                    "per_field_verdicts": {},
                    "judge_concerns": [],
                    "document_assets": {"resume_file": str(outside_pdf)},
                },
            )
            print("pre_generated:", pre_generated_tailored_resume_path(state))
            sel = select_existing_resume_result(state)
            print(
                "selection:",
                "None" if sel is None else (sel.assets.resume_file, sel.selection.lane.lane_id),
            )
            command = await node_tailor_documents(state)
            print("command:", command)
            if hasattr(command, "update"):
                print("update:", command.update)


asyncio.run(main())
